author: opencode-worker-1
text: Worker-1 exploration notes for the implementer (released unimplemented per timebox - the test needs wire-format work beyond this round's budget). ALL FIXTURES/POINTS VERIFIED IN-TREE 2026-09-04: (1) RX expiry gate: receive.rs:709-715 - expired or unassessable clock -> DioRootSigOutcome::Baseline (returns BEFORE cross_check, so the DIO fields need not match the vector payload for the expired case; only Dio::from_bytes parse + 0x17 option presence + pin + structural verify must pass). Unassessable clock = wall_clock_unix None (the provisioning default, provisioning.rs:62) - so the clockless case needs NO clock setup. (2) Gate preconditions to satisfy: Dio::from_bytes(dio_body) parses (dio_body starts at IPV6_HEADER_LEN + hdr_field::BODY_OFFSET, rpl_code::DIO at IPV6_HEADER_LEN+1); exactly one 0x17 OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE option after Dio::SERIALIZED_LEN (duplicates -> Reject); announces.pinned_pubkey_for(root_iid) must return the vector pubkey (root_iid 203df4662ab81f5a, pubkey VALID_PUBKEY from root_sig.rs:433 fixtures). (3) THE PIN BACKDOOR (required): the vector has no private key, so no announce can pin it - add #[cfg(test)] pin_for_test(iid, pubkey) to AnnounceProcessor (announce.rs:304 pinned_pubkey_for / :274 pinned_keys.insert show the shape; note iid must equal iid_from_pubkey(pubkey) or cached_seq lookups fail closed) plus a #[cfg(test)] announces_mut() accessor on RplStack (mod.rs:214 has the immutable one). (4) PACKET ASSEMBLY: Dio struct (rpl_instance_id 0, version 1, rank 256, mop 2, dodag_id from the vector payload - root_sig.rs:39-47 RootSigPayload fields confirmed) + append the 0x17 option carrying VALID_COSE_SIGN1 (122 bytes; check message.rs option-length encoding for >127 - RootDioSignature::write_to exists and presumably handles it); wrap with rpl_ipv6_packet (transmit.rs, pub(crate)) to RPL_ALL_NODES (canonical multicast - the only admitted DIO delivery per the ehcn contract) and send via RplStack send_ipv6 (transmit.rs:158, link-signing automatic). (5) ASSERTS: expired-clock run -> outcome is NOT RplRejected (Baseline proceeds to process_authenticated_dio); clockless run (no set_wall_clock_unix) -> same. Positive control (optional): clock BEFORE expiry + correct DIO fields -> cross_check passes -> also not rejected, but root_seq cached (RootSeqCache) - distinguishing Verified from Baseline requires a cache accessor; keep the test to the not-rejected pin if that is intrusive. (6) CAUTION: sibling three_rpl_stacks test is RED (ehcn-gated) - do not route through unicast DIO delivery.
